title: Follow a task to a verified done
goal: You want to know whether a finished task is actually proven, not just marked complete. Starting from the board, find out what backs up its done-ness.
steps: Find a task that claims to be done
Open it and find whether it was verified
Follow the verification to the evidence behind it
See the per-criterion outcomes and at least one artefact the panel captured
Tell apart a task that passed verification from one that is merely marked done
